intro: Titus is a short letter to Paul's co-worker on the island of Crete, about building a healthy church.
Chapter one: choosing good leaders. Chapter two: teaching every age to live well. Chapter three: being ready to do good, because of God's kindness to us.
Paul wrote it late in his life.
Listen for the grace of God, which teaches us how to live.

card.parts: Ch. 1: leaders | Ch. 2: every age | Ch. 3: doing good
card.key: The grace of God hath appeared (2) · Not by works (3)
